name: Berean color themes
status: Decided Oct 31, 2026 (Owen, via Wren). See themes-spec.md §Decisions.

source.package: Kerning & Co. themes package (Iris, Nova, Hinge, Pebble), Oct 31, 2026
source.generator: build_tokens.py (studio tool, not in the repo); this file is normalized from its output with values copied byte-exact

colorFormat: Opaque sRGB hex, #RRGGBB, uppercase (material3 scrim and scrimWarm are rgba()). oklch values are [L, C, H], L 0..1, H in degrees; the recorded C is the one actually used after sRGB gamut mapping.

modeNotes.lightIC: Light with the system Increase Contrast setting on.
modeNotes.darkIC: Dark with the system Increase Contrast setting on.

notes: All colors are opaque sRGB hex, except material3 scrim and scrimWarm, which are rgba() because a scrim must dim whatever is behind it. Highlights and selection are solid, pre-blended fills drawn behind body text, never alpha.
Link text is textPrimary; the underline is the non-color cue. linkUnderline colors only that underline (1 px, 3 px offset) and is decorative, with no contrast floor.
textTertiary is for placeholders only, and every field also has a visible label; separator and linkUnderline are decorative only.
focusRing is accent slot 1 for the mode. At runtime the focus ring follows the accent the user picked; every slot passes the 3:1 focus-ring floor.

Highlights carry no meaning and have no category names. Keys are color names, matching the Rust core's HighlightColor names; the array order is the display order (yellow, green, blue, pink, purple, orange), independent of the core's ColorIndex. Map by name, never by position. name is the visible label; spokenName is what screen readers say ("Yellow highlight").
oklch values are [L, C, H] with L 0..1. Chroma may be reduced by sRGB gamut mapping; the recorded C is the one actually used, and each reduction is listed in the slot's flags.

paper.name: Paper
paper.character: The current Berean look: warm, bright, lightly toned paper with near-black brown ink. Crisp but never stark; the default.

slots.name: Terracotta
flags: light: pinned baseline #9B3F2A; OKLCH L 0.489 vs shared 0.489 (Δ -0.000), C 0.128 vs 0.125, H 34.3
dark: pinned baseline #E59A7C; OKLCH L 0.754 vs shared 0.754 (Δ -0.000), C 0.100 vs 0.100, H 42.6

sepia.name: Sepia
sepia.character: Deeper, buttery parchment with soft brown ink. Lower contrast than Paper (about 11.7:1 on the page) to ease long sessions, while staying above every floor.

stone.name: Stone
stone.character: A cool, quiet grey with a faint blue cast, like limestone and slate. Neutral and modern, with graphite ink.

sage.name: Sage
sage.character: Muted green-grey, like dried herbs and lichen. Low stimulation: soft chroma everywhere, accents and highlights pulled down a notch.
